scientific_integrity: All finite quotient cells, 300 free-face collapses, and 462 generator eliminations are reconstructed and checked from the embedded source and certificate. scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the ordinary geometric transpose quotient of the standard four-by-four chessboard complex. The proof is a complete replayable finite cellular calculation plus standard homotopy theorems; no claim for other board sizes or fixed/Borel quotients. An equivalent unindexed earlier result cannot be excluded.
title: The transpose quotient of the four-by-four chessboard complex is a wedge of six two-spheres
